scope: The standing Kaohsiung Mosque on Jianjyun Road, with the green glazed-tile portico, arched glazing, tiled entry approach and the principal mosque roof and towers.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla-published 2019 view. Shows the green tile grid, projecting triple arch portico, signing band, tall flank windows, approach stair and low planters.

quallaSearch.notes: Selected the published Qualla own-work CC0 facade original as the first visual source. The other public-domain or CC0 files in the article depict other locations. Written city and Islamic Union records supplement the facade for the rooftop architectural form.
